about: Docs/Design/84 §15.3: the talk scorecard (tools/talk_score.py), from talk_sim transcripts.

R4.name: distinctive line heard again within 10 h, per 100 h

R7.name: distinct reply entries per 1,000 reply beats

R8.name: habit saturation (% of a speaker's lines, mean)

C1Q.name: questions answered: the '?' heuristic (%)
C1Q.target: diagnostic (C1 until Phase 3; doesn't separate from the control)

C2.name: replies at the best fit available (%)

C3.name: endings by a farewell or a marked break (%)

C6.name: same entry or question twice in a conversation, per 1,000

T3.name: self-reference errors (own name, the listener in the third person, unbacked eyewitness words), per 1,000 lines

T4.name: identity drift: a stance changed with no event or concede, or answered against one's own, per 1,000 stance lines

T6.name: 'they' said of one known wolf named in the line, per 1,000 lines

D1A.name: lines said a step broader or plainer than the speaker's own accent (%)

T5.name: telling what the listener already believes, with no 'known' answer (%)

D1.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): accent none

D1L.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): light speakers

D1B.name: lines with a dialect's words (%): broad speakers

D2.name: another dialect's words in a speaker's line

D3.name: dialect guessed from 20 lines (%): light and broad

U1.name: a resident's lines from their own words (%)

K3.name: same news told twice to the same resident

W3.name: a resident answers chat with the option off

X1.name: lexical cohesion: replies sharing a content word with the line before (%)
X1.target: diagnostic (not in §15.3): shows the control is discriminating

examples: children: My son rides with the Coldwater caravan. (rm_wenna_tarford, indoors/rain 17h)
rm_edmund_sootdale: More of it. We'd only just done talking of the last. A thief took Wenna Tarford's things. They'll be disappointed.
rmx_lionel_lowe: A cutpurse took Josephine Wetmore's things. Hope they like them.
rm_winifred_pitchdale: I walked mine to the well this morning, after Gudrun Wickby. They thought I'd gone soft.
rm_edmund_sootdale: A cutpurse took Oda Cinderby's things. Hope they like them.
rm_edmund_sootdale: A light-pawed sort took Dirk Mallory's things. They'll be disappointed.
rmx_ulla_brindle: Somebody robbed Wynn Rustworth. I hope they wiped their paws.
Everyone's been told. Florence Pennock is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. / rm_imogen_ashby: I hope they find her, then.
Nobody's saying who robbed Rosamund Tarridge. Everybody knows not to. / rmx_ebba_netherby: Wise of them.
And another thing. Right, you. Listen. Rupert Greyley is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. / Well, I never.
A stick. Gods help us. / It's a good stick!
rmx_grete_dunn: A light-pawed sort took Dagny Slaghand's things. Hope they like them.
Now it's Rosamund Tarridge. The road wolves have come into town. / rm_mathis_slagwell: Or one of ours, using them as cover.
Good day. A clerk at the City Office told me Desmond Ashwick tried to steal from Orla Wickby. Clerks know everything. / rm_signe_sootwell: They do.
And that's not the only trouble about. Finn Dripwick! In broad day! And the watch drinking somewhere! / rm_oda_slagby: I'd bite them! Right on the tail!
My neighbour nailed their shutters shut after Finn Dripwick. / cty_hob_appleby: And how do they get the air in?
A light-pawed sort took Dagny Slaghand's things. Hope they like them. / rm_aldric_grayrock_: They'll have a fine time with the old chair.
Somebody got Sage Wheatridge. Not me, before you ask. / tn_sm_hob_cornwell: Oh, no. Oh, that's terrible. Did they take the goose?
You'll want to know this. Finn Saltwell is wanted by the Watch for attempted theft. / rm_maren_brineford: I hope they find him, then.
There's more, mind. Bar the door tonight. Pell Plumgarth tried to steal from Ebba Heath. / It'll come right in the end.
There's more, mind. You'll like this one. Rika Gullwell tried to steal from Dagny Slaghand. / I'd not repeat it till it's proved.
And that's not all I've heard. I heard the grown-ups. Soren Ashcote tried to steal from Gudrun Wickby! I'm not supposed to know. / What does that mean?
And that's not all I've heard. Quietly. Frida Rainhand tried to steal from Edric Millton. / Truly? You'd not lie to me.
tn_oh_varg_acorndell: Jory Rimepeak's family are coming for the festival. All of them.
Couldn't say how many. Enough. / Work won't wait.
Come back to haggle? Vale Miremore has taken up the whistle. Badly. / tn_oh_quill_oakdell: Bring them by. I've honey cakes.
Home's where the supper is. Vale Miremore hides the honey from me. I always find it. / tn_oh_quill_oakdell: Give them my best.

R6_detail.line: I can't tomorrow. Another time, I promise.

I'll pray for Wenna Tarford's cutpurse. Truly. / rmx_philippa_coldby: Pray they're caught, I hope you mean.
Wenna Tarford, of all folk. A chapel-goer! / rmx_philippa_coldby: Hm. Wonder where they'll sell it.
Nobody's saying who robbed Josephine Fenwick. Everybody knows not to. / rmx_ivar_netherworth: Wise of them.
Whoever did Josephine Fenwick walks about free. It makes my blood boil. / rm_winifred_cinderworth: And the Watch sitting on their tails!
